 UTICA, N.Y. -- A Utica man faces drug charges after a vehicle stop. 
According to the Utica Police Department, investigators charged Michael Williams, 30, of Utica, on Nov. 11, as part of an ongoing investigation into the sale and distribution of narcotics.
During a vehicle stop, UPD said, " felony weight narcotics were located on Williams." 
Williams was taken to the Utica Police Department and charged with criminal possession of a controlled substance and criminal sale of a controlled substance.
